headline: Australian charts shut out mostly-AI songs
body: A quiet day. Australia's ARIA said tracks made mostly or wholly by AI will be excluded from its music charts from Friday, a small sign of Tech Backlash that lifted Reversion. Other endings drifted by a few hundredths as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance holds at -2.70.
movers_note: Reversion +0.2, from ARIA's ban on mostly-AI songs (+0.14) and fading earlier news (+0.02). Descendants -0.06, from fading earlier news (-0.06).
coming_up: ARIA excludes mostly-AI tracks from Australian charts from Friday
